base_weapons.name: Rusty Shiv
base_weapons.flavor: It's insulting that I'm holding this. But it gets the job done.

base_weapons.name: Iron Claymore
base_weapons.flavor: Finally, something with weight. Compensating for something? Yes. Your incompetence.

base_weapons.name: Bone Whip
base_weapons.flavor: Vertebrae from something that annoyed me. Poetic.

base_weapons.name: Forbidden Tome
base_weapons.flavor: Forbidden to mortals. Bedtime reading for me.

base_weapons.name: Silver Rapier
base_weapons.flavor: Elegant. Precise. Everything you aren't.

base_weapons.name: Acid Vial
base_weapons.flavor: I could dissolve your ambitions with this. And your face.

base_weapons.name: Ember Staff
base_weapons.flavor: Burns at the temperature of my contempt. So, very hot.

base_weapons.name: War Maul
base_weapons.flavor: Subtlety is overrated. This isn't subtle.

base_weapons.name: Spirit Lantern
base_weapons.flavor: It holds a trapped soul. Don't worry, it deserved it.

base_weapons.name: Sonic Bell
base_weapons.flavor: Rings at a frequency that makes lesser beings reconsider existing.

base_weapons.name: Frozen Scepter
base_weapons.flavor: Cold as my opinion of you. Which is saying something.

base_weapons.name: Chain Hook
base_weapons.flavor: Drags them closer. So I can be disappointed at point-blank range.

base_weapons.name: Runic Greataxe
base_weapons.flavor: Big. Glowing. Overcompensating. I approve.

base_weapons.name: Venom Fang Dagger
base_weapons.flavor: Small but every cut is a promise of something worse.

base_weapons.name: Thunderclap Gauntlet
base_weapons.flavor: Punches so hard the sound arrives late. Rude and effective.

base_weapons.name: Spectral Scythe
base_weapons.flavor: Cuts the soul. The body just follows along out of politeness.

base_weapons.name: Molten Flail
base_weapons.flavor: A ball of molten iron on a chain. Subtle as a supernova.

base_weapons.name: Blessed Mace
base_weapons.flavor: Blessed by a lesser god. I could do better, but it'll do.

base_weapons.name: Shadow Needle
base_weapons.flavor: Thin as a whisper. Hurts like a scream.

base_weapons.name: Alchemist's Crossbow
base_weapons.flavor: Shoots bolts that melt on impact. Science was a mistake. A beautiful mistake.

base_weapons.name: Frostbite Dagger
base_weapons.flavor: Cold steel. Warmer than my opinion of you.

base_weapons.name: Inferno Pike
base_weapons.flavor: A spear of spite and open flame.

base_weapons.name: Stormglass Wand
base_weapons.flavor: It hums before it hurts.

base_weapons.name: Glacier Chakram
base_weapons.flavor: It returns. Unlike your dignity.

base_weapons.name: Godsthorn Needle
base_weapons.flavor: Thin as intent. Carries divine weight. You don't touch what belongs to God.

base_weapons.name: Obsidian Cleaver
base_weapons.flavor: Acts on intent, not action. Makes them bleed and wonder why they stood there.

base_weapons.name: Runebrand Whip
base_weapons.flavor: Inscribed with seventeen curses. I wrote fourteen of them on a slow afternoon.

base_weapons.name: Ashen Crossbow
base_weapons.flavor: Shoots bolts that arrive already burning. Everything is better on fire.

base_weapons.name: Void Crystal
base_weapons.flavor: It hums before it hurts. Whatever it is, it isn't from here.

base_weapons.name: Bile Flask
base_weapons.flavor: Disgusting. Effective. I could dissolve ambitions with this. And faces.

base_weapons.name: Silver Moonshard
base_weapons.flavor: Cannot be moved without consent. Cuts what shouldn't be cuttable.

base_weapons.name: Siren's Harp
base_weapons.flavor: Plays a note that makes lesser beings reconsider their life choices. Immediately.

base_weapons.name: Frozen Greatclub
base_weapons.flavor: A slab of permafrost on a handle. Subtle as a glacier. Effective as contempt.

base_weapons.name: Judgment Gauntlet
base_weapons.flavor: Acts on intent, not action. I decide if the hit lands. It always does.

base_weapons.name: Asterion, Star-Eater Blade
base_weapons.flavor: A named relic. It remembers better wars than this one.
